segments.pv17:1.3: Bāhā paggayha kandasi, vanamajjhe kiṃ dukkhito tuvan”ti.
segments.pv17:2.3: Tassa cakkayugaṃ na vindāmi, tena dukkhena jahāmi jīvitan”ti.
segments.pv17:3.1: “Sovaṇṇamayaṃ maṇimayaṃ, lohitakamayaṃ [lohitaṅgamayaṃ (syā.), lohitaṅkamayaṃ (sī.), lohamayaṃ (katthaci)] atha rūpiyamayaṃ;
segments.pv17:3.3: Ācikkha me bhaddamāṇava, cakkayugaṃ paṭipādayāmi te”ti.
segments.pv17:4.1: So māṇavo tassa pāvadi,“candasūriyā ubhayettha dissare;
segments.pv17:4.3: Sovaṇṇamayo ratho mama, tena cakkayugena sobhatī”ti.
segments.pv17:5.1: “Bālo kho tvaṃ asi māṇava, yo tvaṃ patthayase apatthiyaṃ;
segments.pv17:5.3: Maññāmi tuvaṃ marissasi, na hi tvaṃ lacchasi candasūriye”ti.
segments.pv17:6.3: Peto kālakato na dissati, ko nidha kandataṃ bālyataro”ti.
segments.pv17:7.1: “Saccaṃ kho vadesi māṇava, ahameva kandataṃ bālyataro;
segments.pv17:7.3: Candaṃ viya dārako rudaṃ, petaṃ kālakatābhipatthayin”ti.
segments.pv17:8.3: Vārinā viya osiñcaṃ, sabbaṃ nibbāpaye daraṃ.
segments.pv17:9.1: “Abbahī [abbūḷhaṃ (syā. ka.)] vata me sallaṃ, sokaṃ hadayanissitaṃ;
segments.pv17:10.3: Na socāmi na rodāmi, tava sutvāna māṇavā”ti.
segments.pv17:11.3: Ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayan”ti.
segments.pv17:12.1: “Yañca kandasi yañca rodasi, puttaṃ āḷāhane sayaṃ dahitvā;
segments.pv17:12.3: Svāhaṃ kusalaṃ karitvā kammaṃ, tidasānaṃ sahabyataṃ gato”ti.
segments.pv17:13.1: “Appaṃ vā bahuṃ vā nāddasāma, dānaṃ dadantassa sake agāre;
segments.pv17:13.3: Uposathakammaṃ vā tādisaṃ, kena kammena gatosi devalokan”ti.
segments.pv17:14.3: Buddhaṃ vigatarajaṃ vitiṇṇakaṅkhaṃ, addakkhiṃ sugataṃ anomapaññaṃ.
segments.pv17:15.3: Tāhaṃ kusalaṃ karitvāna kammaṃ, tidasānaṃ sahabyataṃ gato”ti.
segments.pv17:16.1: “Acchariyaṃ vata abbhutaṃ vata, añjalikammassa ayamīdiso vipāko;
segments.pv17:16.3: Ahampi muditamano pasannacitto, ajjeva buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ vajāmī”ti.
segments.pv17:17.1: “Ajjeva buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ vajāhi, dhammañca saṅghañca pasannacitto;
segments.pv17:17.3: Tatheva sikkhāya padāni pañca, akhaṇḍaphullāni samādiyassu.
segments.pv17:18.3: Amajjapo mā ca musā bhaṇāhi, sakena dārena ca hohi tuṭṭho”ti.
segments.pv17:19.3: Karomi tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ, tvaṃsi ācariyo mamāti.
